name: Homebound
description: AI-powered lead prioritization and outreach assistant for real estate agents — built to surface who to call next instead of burying it in a spreadsheet. Syncs leads from Follow Up Boss and ranks them with a hybrid rules + LLM scoring engine that explains every verdict in plain language, then matches an agent's own listings against each lead's stated criteria. FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy and the OpenAI API on the backend; Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind on the front; plus an offline-capable PWA for taking notes in the field.

name: FridgeBook
description: Kitchen inventory app that tracks what's in your fridge and pantry, flags what's about to expire, and keeps a shopping list that puts groceries straight into your kitchen once they're bought. A ground-up rebuild of my original bootcamp project. React, React Router and FullCalendar on the front end behind an animated open-fridge landing page; an Express and Sequelize API over PostgreSQL with Umzug-versioned migrations; Google sign-in through Passport OAuth 2.0 with per-user data and Postgres-backed sessions; 100+ automated tests running in GitHub Actions on every push. API on Render, front end on Netlify.
